description.en: Draws Korean text in its own character forms where the system has no font for it (Linux without Noto Sans CJK, subtitles on iPhone). Downloaded by itself when needed.
description.zh-Hans: 系统里没有韩文字体时（没装 Noto Sans CJK 的 Linux、iPhone 上的字幕），用它按韩文字形显示。需要时自动下载。
